answer: Re-attestations are stored in relic and saffron lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the juniper graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 816 impostors cost 1188 times the honest price and take 20 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
